name: Novotel Kuala Lumpur City Centre
short_description: A 302-room hotel between the Petronas Twin Towers and Bukit Bintang, a 5-minute walk to Pavilion KL via a link bridge, near Raja Chulan Monorail.
ai_summary: Novotel Kuala Lumpur City Centre sits on Jalan Kia Peng in the Golden Triangle, between the Petronas Twin Towers and Bukit Bintang, with a link bridge putting Pavilion Kuala Lumpur about a 5-minute walk away and Raja Chulan Monorail station nearby. The 302 smoke-free rooms come with a coffee/tea corner, in-room safe, and drinking-water filtration, and the property adds The Zen Spa and international dining at The Square. Guests consistently praise the central, quiet-yet-connected location and attentive housekeeping, with breakfast and front-desk consistency the main areas where reviews are mixed.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Kuala Lumpur City Centre near Pavilion Mall?
faqs.answer: Yes -- a link bridge connects the hotel to Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, about a 5-minute walk away, and the property also sits within reach of the Petronas Twin Towers and Bukit Bintang in KL's Golden Triangle.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Kuala Lumpur City Centre have a spa?
faqs.answer: Yes -- The Zen Spa offers aromatherapy treatments on-site, alongside an outdoor pool and international dining at The Square restaurant.
